name: Annotated Beethoven Corpus
desc: Harmonic analysis of the Beethoven String Quartets.

name: Beethoven Piano Sonata with Functional Harmony dataset (BPS-FH)
desc: harmonic and formal analyses of the first movements of Beethoven Piano Sonatas.

name: GTTM
desc: Masatoshi Hamanaka's XML markups of musical examples from (and using the tree structure representation of) A Generative Theory of Tonal Music (Lerdahl and Jackendoff 1983).

name: Taking-Form
desc: formal analysis of c.150 Mozart and Beethoven movements along with conversion code.

name: TAVERN
desc: Theme And Variation Encodings with Roman Numerals. 27 sets of variations by Mozart and Beethoven.

name: When in Rome
desc: a collection of harmonic analysis datasets in the 'Roman Text' format combining new corpora with conversions of all existing ones (ABC, BPS-FH, and TAVERN as above).
